The '''Garen system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="TEA232" /> that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garen IV/Legends|Garen IV]]<ref name="FAJ8" /> and was located within the [[Thuldin's Grant sector/Legends|Thuldin's Grant sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Garen IV housed an Imperial [[Garen IV penal colony|penal colony]], although<ref name="FAJ8" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]],<ref name="Date">"[[Firepower]]" places the [[Raid on Garen IV|raid]] on [[Garen IV/Legends|Garen IV]] five [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before its main story, which is set in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a number of [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] escaped the colony during a [[Raid on Garen IV|raid]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="FAJ8" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Garen system was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]] and released in [[2009]]. The book placed it in grid square J-15.<ref name="TEA232">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
